title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Government Debt & Infrastructure Finance - Brazil

description.narrative: This project will help strengthen the Government of Brazils Investment Partnership Program as well as provide support to the Ministry of Transport where many of the infrastructure projects will originate. Advisor will: to help strengthen the Government of Brazils Investment Partnership Program as well as provide support to the Ministry of Transport where many of the infrastructure projects will originate; Assist PPI in developing a set of gateways that each project must meet in the development process to be considered for federal funding; Work with the Ministry of Transport to prepare critical projects for private investment in the rail sector; and Work with the Ministry of Transport to attract new private capital for key projects in the port sector.
